data.raw_text:
NOW: Rights group Karapatan leads protest action at the Department of Justice headquarters in Manila, June 26, on the International Day in Support of Victims of Torture. 

Progressives are calling to release the over 700 political prisoners in the country, especially the sick and the elderly. They call out the government’s continued scheme of jailing and torturing activists and civil society actors under trumped-up charges. According to groups, this modus coincides with the existing ‘counter-insurgency’ program which they claim also targets non-combatants and activists based in urban centers.
